Context: 8. Review of Suspension

- GID.5 (26) and (17)., Rule 110 (6) and (7), Chapter 3.  
In a case where no charge-sheet is issued, the total period under suspension or deemed suspension, as the case may be, including any  
extended period shall not exceed-  
- (a) 270
- days from the date of order of suspension, if disciplinary proceeding is contemplated or is pending against the Government servant
